findings.problem: offer_parameters collects the entire iterator before enforcing the existing maximum of four parameters; from_profile also preallocates and copies the full input before that bound.
findings.contract: Recoverable invalid configuration must be rejected with bounded work at its existing input boundary.
findings.cause: Collection precedes validate_offer_parameters; profile conversion reserves settings.permessage_deflate_offer.len().
findings.remedy: Read at most the fifth parameter and reject without reading a sixth; check profile length before duplicate allocation, preserving supported order and values.
findings.reproduction: Test iterator yields five items and records a sixth read. Require InvalidRequest and exactly five item reads; add an independently ordered valid four-parameter control.
findings.status: Source-supported and accepted for a separate bounded lane; no runtime reproduction claimed here.
findings.scope: Caller configuration boundary, not a demonstrated remote input exploit.
